name: dumbbell rear lunge front raise
description: Step back into a lunge and raise the dumbbells in front. It trains the legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your thighs.
Step one foot back into a lunge.
As you lower, raise the dumbbells in front to shoulder height.
Push through your front foot to stand back up.
Lower the dumbbells as you return.
